description: 2026 Jeep Wrangler 4-Door Rubicon 4x4: Conquer the High Desert Imagine heading out on a Saturday morning from your home in Victorville, CA, with the doors off and the sun hitting the Bright White Clearcoat paint as you make your way toward the open trails of the Mojave. The 2026 Jeep Wrangler 4-Door Rubicon 4x4 isn't just a vehicle; it is a ticket to the rugged lifestyle that defines our region. Whether you are navigating the suburban streets of Apple Valley, CA, or looking for a weekend escape into the mountains, this Rubicon is engineered to handle the unique demands of the High Desert with ease and style. Performance & Capability Under the hood of this Rubicon lies a sophisticated 2.0L I-4 gasoline direct injection, DOHC, intercooled turbo engine, delivering a stout 270HP. This powerplant is paired with a TorqueFlite 8-speed automatic transmission, ensuring smooth power delivery whether you are cruising the freeway or crawling over rocks. The Rock-Trac part-time 4WD system provides the mechanical grip needed for serious exploration, supported by ELocker driver selectable front and rear locking differentials that allow you to maintain traction in the most challenging silt or loose rock found near Hesperia, CA. The suspension setup is pure Jeep heritage, featuring a Performance Suspension with a Quadra-Coil off-road ride system and a Dana 44 rigid axle in the rear. For those technical sections, the Front anti-roll bar disconnect and Off Road Plus Mode allow for maximum articulation and optimized throttle response. To protect the vitals while you explore, this model is equipped with 5 underbody skid plates and heavy-duty gas-pressurized shock absorbers. Even with this immense capability, the Auto stop-start engine technology helps maintain efficiency during your daily errands around town. Technology & Connectivity Inside the cabin, the 2026 Wrangler Rubicon bridges the gap between rugged utility and modern innovation. The centerpiece is the massive 12.3-inch primary touchscreen display featuring the latest Uconnect 5 system. This interface provides seamless Wireless streaming and Smart device integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, allowing you to access your maps and music without fumbling for cords. Communication is effortless thanks to Handsfree Uconnect with Bluetooth, and the Voice activated audio controls ensure your focus stays on the trail or the road ahead. With 7 USB ports and a 4G LTE Wi-Fi Hot Spot, everyone in the vehicle can stay connected and charged during long drives. The 7.00-inch gauge cluster display provides vital vehicle information at a glance, while the integrated center stack radio keeps the entertainment controls within easy reach. Comfort & Interior The interior of this Rubicon is finished in durable Black Cloth front seat upholstery, designed to stand up to the dust and grit of a desert lifestyle. The Dual-zone front climate control with Voice-activated climate control ensures both the driver and passenger remain comfortable regardless of the outside temperature. For added utility, the cabin features a 120V AC power outlet, perfect for charging gear while camping or working remotely. Storage is abundant and secure, featuring a Locking cargo area concealed storage bin and a Locking floor console storage unit to keep your valuables safe when the top is off. The 60-40 folding rear seats provide flexibility for hauling gear, and the Carpet and rubber cargo mat makes cleanup easy after a day in the dirt. With Power windows, Power door mirrors, and Remote keyless entry, this Jeep offers the convenience features necessary for a comfortable daily commute through the High Desert. Safety & Driver Assistance Safety is paramount, whether you are on a crowded highway or a remote trail. This Wrangler is equipped with Advanced Brake Assist and 4-Wheel Disc Brakes with a four-channel ABS system for confident stopping power. The Full Speed Forward Collision Warning Plus and Adaptive Cruise Control w/Stop & Go provide an extra layer of protection and convenience during heavy traffic. Parking and reversing are made simple with the ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera, providing a clear view of what is behind you on the large touchscreen. The vehicle is surrounded by a comprehensive 6-airbag system, including Curtain first and second-row overhead airbags. Additionally, the Tire Fill Alert system makes it easy to adjust your tire pressures for off-roading and then quickly return them to street levels for the drive home. Exterior & Design The exterior of this Rubicon is striking in Bright White Clearcoat, accented by the iconic Body-color grille with colored accents and Black fender flares. It sits tall on 17-inch Machined Wheels with Black Pockets wrapped in LT285/70R17C BSW Off-Road Tires. The Black 3-Piece Hard Top offers a quiet ride and security, while the Removable sunroof and targa composite panels allow for that classic open-air Jeep experience. Functional exterior features include 2 front tow hooks and a rear tow hook, along with a Class II Receiver Hitch and Trailer wiring harness for light towing duties. The Steel Performance Hood adds an aggressive touch to the front end, while LED low and high beam headlights, LED front fog lights, and LED daytime running lights ensure maximum visibility during night drives through the darker stretches of the desert. Key Highlights The 2026 Jeep Wrangler Rubicon is packed with features designed for the enthusiast who refuses to compromise on utility or technology.  2.0L Turbo Engine - Powerful and efficient performance with 270HP. Rock-Trac 4WD - Professional-grade hardware for extreme off-road capability. Tru-Lok Differentials - Electronic locking front and rear differentials for maximum grip. 12.3-inch Touchscreen - Large, high-resolution display for navigation and media. Wireless Apple CarPlay/Android Auto - Easy smartphone integration without cables. Black 3-Piece Hard Top - Versatile roof system for all-weather protection. Adaptive Cruise Control - Maintains a safe distance from traffic automatically. 4G LTE Wi-Fi Hot Spot - Stay connected even in remote locations. Class II Receiver Hitch - Ready for towing small trailers or bike racks. LED Lighting Group - Superior illumination with LED headlights and fog lights. Off-Road Plus Mode - Optimizes vehicle systems for different terrain types. Steel Performance Hood - Distinctive styling with functional cooling. ParkView Rear Camera - Clear visibility for easier reversing and hitching. 7 USB Ports - Plenty of charging options for all passengers. 115V Auxiliary Power Outlet - Household-style plug for charging larger electronics. A head-up display projects important driving information directly into the driver's line of sight, while connected services and data-based features may require subscription services. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Rear camera - Watching your back!  The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe. Head-up display - Keep your head up! You don't have to take your eyes off of the road to get information from your dashboard anymore. With head-up display, important driving information - like speed and RPM's - displays on your windshield in your line of sight. What this vehicle includes:            Safety and Security Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Rear camera - Watching your back!  The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.Technology and Telematics Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system.  Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road. Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicle's private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. Find the hotspot with mobile hotspot.     Come on in to DeFouw Nissan of Lafayette today at 450 Sagamore Pkwy S Lafayette IN 47905 or call  to schedule a test drive!
